out_of_scope_note: This assistant covers three everyday problems: (1) landlord not returning a security deposit, (2) refund/defective product or service, (3) unpaid salary. It can also explain a notice you received in plain language. It does NOT handle criminal cases, police/FIR/arrest, domestic violence, divorce/custody, property/title disputes, or anything already in court.

general_entries.title: Old IPC is replaced; cheating is now a BNS offence
general_entries.summary: Since 1 July 2024 the Indian Penal Code (IPC) no longer applies to new offences; it was replaced by the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). Cheating (old IPC 420) is now Section 318 BNS. Deciding whether a money dispute is actually a crime is complex: most deposit/refund/salary disputes are civil, and wrongly filing a criminal complaint can backfire.
general_entries.use_when: ONLY when the user asks to file a criminal/IPC/cheating case. Correct the outdated law and recommend a lawyer; do not encourage criminal complaints.
general_entries.caveat: Criminal matters are out of scope; always recommend a lawyer.
general_entries.verified_via: IPC 420 -> BNS 318(4) mapping per court records quoted in LiveLaw/Drishti (checked 2026-11-08)
